title: Tiny, cute lighthouse
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6a8' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- light beams -->
  <polygon points='50,24 6,10 6,30' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.35'/>
  <polygon points='50,24 94,10 94,30' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- glow around lamp -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='16' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- rocky base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#7a6a8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='28' ry='6' fill='#9a8aab'/>
  <!-- tower body -->
  <path d='M40 82 L43 42 L57 42 L60 82 Z' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- red stripes -->
  <path d='M42.2 62 L57.8 62 L57.2 54 L42.8 54 Z' fill='#e8474b'/>
  <path d='M43.4 46 L56.6 46 L57 42 L43 42 Z' fill='#e8474b'/>
  <!-- stripe shading -->
  <path d='M57.8 62 L60 82 L56 82 L57.2 54 Z' fill='#d13f43' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- gallery platform -->
  <rect x='37' y='38' width='26' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c94b8a'/>
  <rect x='37' y='41' width='26' height='2' rx='1' fill='#a83a70'/>
  <!-- lantern room walls -->
  <rect x='43' y='26' width='14' height='12' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <rect x='43' y='26' width='4' height='12' fill='#e0b03a'/>
  <!-- lamp -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#fff'/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <path d='M41 26 L50 14 L59 26 Z' fill='#e8474b'/>
  <path d='M50 14 L59 26 L54 26 Z' fill='#c93a3e'/>
  <!-- roof knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='2' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='46' y='70' width='8' height='13' rx='4' fill='#c94b8a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='77' r='1' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
